messages:
emma: Heads up — noticed inconsistent param names for the /v1/generate API across the API ref, Go SDK snippet, and the curl example. Docs use `prompt`, the Go snippet uses `Input`, and examples show `input`.
emma: This is causing confusion in customer integration guides and the migration doc. We should standardize on `prompt` in the API ref and add a short note in the SDK migration section.
kai: I can take a PR for this. Want the minimal change (docs + examples) or do we also update the Go SDK snippet to match the SDK package naming?
emma: Minimal first: fix API ref examples and the curl/python snippets, plus a follow-up PR to update the Go SDK package example to idiomatic struct names. Also add a compatibility note: server accepts `input` for a release cycle.
oliver: For the OpenAPI file: the request schema currently has `input: string` and `maxTokens: integer`. We standardize to `prompt` and `max_new_tokens` to match the generator runtime. Will need a small PR to openapi/examples.
marco: If we change request field names, we should add a migration snippet showing how to map old -> new in customer code. Some enterprise customers still pin old examples in their repos.
docs-bot: Automated check — link-checker found a broken link in the generate examples: https://docs.redwood.ai/generate#old-example — flagged in CI.
emma: Thanks, bot. I'll fix the broken anchor in the examples page as part of the same change set.
kai: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2145
kai: PR includes: - update /v1/generate examples (curl, python, node) to `prompt` - update OpenAPI example request body to `prompt`/`max_new_tokens` - add migration note and a short code snippet mapping `input` -> `prompt`
emma: Nice. Can you also add a snippet for the Go SDK migration? Current wrong snippet in docs:

```go
// old (incorrect) example in docs
req := inference.GenerateRequest{Input: "hello", MaxTokens: 128}
```

emma: Suggest replace with:

```go
req := inference.GenerateRequest{Prompt: "hello", MaxNewTokens: 128}
```

oliver: Ping eng-runtime for a quick compatibility confirm: will the runtime accept `input` as alias? @eng-runtime please confirm before we ship.
marco: For the migration guide, recommend a one-liner: "If you previously used `input`, replace with `prompt`; the server will accept `input` for 30 days post-release." Also add a changelog entry.
kai: I'll include the changelog note and a small unit test that ensures examples in the docs render with the right fields.
emma: Reviewers: @oliver, @marco, @eng-docs. Ideally merged before tomorrow's release cut.
docs-bot: CI status: docs build failed (linker warnings). See https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/9876
kai: On it — fixing the broken anchor plus updating the examples. Will request reviews when ready.
emma: Thanks everyone — leaving a checklist in the PR description for followups (Go SDK snippet update in separate PR, runtime alias confirmation, and changelog).
